chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Safwan, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), in the chapter of Visiting the House on the Day of Sacrifice, said:

Visit it (the Kaaba), and if you are occupied, it will not harm you to visit the House the next day. Do not delay visiting from your day, for it is disliked for the Mutamatti' (one performing Hajj with combination of Umrah and Hajj) to delay it, and it is permissible for the Mufrid (one performing single Hajj) to delay it.

key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference in ruling for delaying Tawaf between Mutamatti' and Mufrid pilgrims?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Tusi’s *al-Istibsar* from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), this hadith clarifies the jurisprudential distinction between the *Mutamatti'* and *Mufrid* pilgrims regarding the timing of Tawaf al-Ziyarah. It establishes that while the *Mutamatti'* is encouraged to perform Tawaf on the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah, delaying it is merely disliked (*makruh*), whereas the *Mufrid* has full flexibility to postpone it without religious penalty.
